2893-4762-7886-8289.easyPrerequisites:
You control five or more Forests.
Fertilid has two or more +1/+1 counters on it.
2893-4762-7886-8289.description:
Activate Fertilid by paying {1}{G} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, causing you to search your library for a basic Forest and put it onto the battlefield tapped.
When the Forest enters, Beorn's Hospitality and Roiling Canopy trigger.
Resolve the Beorn's Hospitality trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on Fertilid.
Resolve the Roiling Canopy trigger, giving Devoted Druid +3/+3 until end of turn.
Activate Devoted Druid's first ability by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Devoted Druid's second ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping it.
Repeat steps 5 and 6 once.
Repeat from step 1.
2893-4762-7886-8289.notes: Each loop, Devoted Druid will net +1/+1. This can let you gain more {G}, and that {G} can then fetch non-Forest basic lands with Fertilid.

574-1445-2279-4871.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in hand and a creature card in your graveyard.
574-1445-2279-4871.description:
Activate Tortured Existence by paying {B} and discarding a creature card, returning another creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
Quintorius triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Vish Kal by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Vish Kal ability.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.
574-1445-2279-4871.notes: Once Vish Kal has infinite +1/+1 counters, you may activate its last ability any number of times to reduce the toughnesses of any number of creatures to 0.

670-1619-3388-5361.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.

670-1619-3388-5361.description:
Put any nontoken creature onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters, Radiant Solar, Moritte of the Frost and Auton Soldier each trigger.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, causing you to venture into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Moritte of the Frost trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Radiant Solar.
Resolve the Auton Soldier trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Radiant Solar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
670-1619-3388-5361.notes: If you are currently venturing in a dungeon when starting the combo, you can complete the dungeon and then use Sefris' second ability to put a creature onto the battlefield to start the combo.

When Karmic Guide enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.

Resolve the Phantom Train ability from step 1.
Cast Priest of Gix from exile by paying at most {2}.
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

When Yawgmoth enters the battlefield, Scurry Oak's evolve ability triggers.
Holding priority, activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Deathgreeter triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on Scurry Oak and causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Scurry Oak trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on it, triggering Scurry Oak's second ability.
Holding priority, activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Deathgreeter triggers, causing you to gain 1 life
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on Scurry Oak and causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Scurry Oak trigger, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token.
When the Squirrel enters the battlefield, Scurry Oak's evolve ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it, triggering Scurry Oak's second ability.
Repeat from step 7.
